from time import sleep
# Physical pin 12 is BCM GPIO18 (the old library's number 6 is a different scheme).
led = LED(18)
while True:
    led.on()
    sleep(0.5)
    led.off()
    sleep(0.5)

text: Fixed: gpiozero uses Broadcom BCM numbering. Physical pin 12 is BCM GPIO18 (the old library's number 6 is a different scheme). Use LED(18).
